name: 05-inverted-regime-a5dae07
description: cam-wyze-pan (T20/jxf22): a genuinely dark room with extreme IR return rests at night-pipeline gain 256-268, BELOW the 300 day threshold - the cold-start verdict is decisively wrong, the machine's probe-tested history is right. Pre-fix this was a perpetual flip loop (trigger floored above the resting gain = permanent false day). Post-fix: one exploratory flip pair plus one probe pair maximum, then quiet night. This scenario also exercises dn_bar_reachable end-to-end: the failed probe latches the ratchet at ~260, whose DN_RATCHET_MARGIN bar (~220) and the planted baseline's probe bar (~210) are both below the 256 floor - the two unsatisfiable-bar warns must appear in the log. It is also the reason the restart-equivalence oracle carries its failed-probe freshness qualifier.

expect_log: brighten ratchet bar \d+ is below the sensor gain floor
brightening probe bar 2\d\d is below the sensor gain floor
